name: bg-animated-gradient
title: Animated Gradient
description: A full-bleed animated gradient built from layered radial colour spots that smoothly cross-fade and drift, meant to sit behind page content.
use: A hero needs a calm, colourful backdrop that moves slowly enough to keep text readable.
avoid: It loops forever and is purely decorative; the saturated purple fights dark or brand-coloured content.
a11y: Decorative with no content of its own; the infinite background animation has no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The whole stage is a soft blurry blend of violet, indigo and magenta with hints of orange. There are no shapes or edges, only broad radial glows that fade into one another.
behaves: The colour spots drift and cross-fade on a linear loop that reverses at each end, so the whole field slides between violet, magenta and blue.
customise: gradients takes colour stops with centre points and animationDuration sets the loop; anything else needs a new gradient array in the demo.
weight: light: One div animating its background gradient; no canvas or extra nodes.
